Zappa Review: The Gnome Wizard of Winter
Zappa: The Blue Shroom Gnome with Fast Hands and Crazy Eyes

Zappa is a 5-star Legendary Ice hero from the Winter Family (Christmas Event), first released in December 2023. He arrives as a Very Fast sniper who summons minions and spreads frost damage like a bad cold at a holiday party. With a design that screams "I ate the wrong mushrooms," Zappa brings a quirky, chaotic energy to the battlefield. However, in a world of modern power creep, players must ask: is this gnome a hidden gem or just garden decor?

Upon release, Zappa was considered "okay but not great." He was overshadowed by the more powerful Cookie and Ginger. He was seen as a fun, niche hero for rush situations or minion teams.
The game has sprinted past Zappa. His stats are nearly 300-600 points behind current heroes. His lack of passives makes him feel like a generic Season 1 hero in a fancy hat.
Zappa is largely a bench warmer for veteran players. He can find use in specific 5-star tournaments or war clean-up teams, but he is not viable for top-tier defense or primary attack teams.

Zappa is the eccentric uncle of the Winter Family. He shows up early (Very Fast), brings weird gifts (mushrooms), and looks a bit crazy. While he can be annoying with his spreading frost, he lacks the raw power to compete with the heavy hitters of the modern era. He's a fun hero for collectors, but don't expect him to carry your team to the top of the leaderboard.
A quirky, fast, but ultimately outdated gnome. Keep him for the art; bench him for the wars.
